clinical_note: INDICATION: NSTEMI. CONCLUSION: Successful culprit PCI to mid LAD today. Plan for staged PCI to severe 90% RCA lesion in 3 to 4 weeks. DAPT continued.
CATH REPORT. IMPRESSION: Severe 3-vessel CAD with LVEF 25%, decompensated congestive heart failure (HFrEF) and atrial fibrillation. Referred for urgent CABG evaluation. No staged PCI.
ANGIOGRAM SUMMARY: Single vessel CAD s/p prior stent. Mild 30% LCx disease. No indication for staged PCI.
TRANSTHORACIC ECHO. FINDINGS: 2D Biplane Simpson's LVEF 42%. Moderate MR. CONCLUSION: Mildly reduced LV systolic function with visually estimated LVEF 40-45%. LVEF improved from prior 25% (2022).
